title: Grauert–Remmert finiteness over an algebraically closed analytic field
statement: Let $K$ be an algebraically closed complete nonarchimedean field with a nontrivial rank-one absolute value and valuation ring $V=\{x:|x|\leq1\}$ [def-trf-valuation-ring]. Let $C$ be a reduced affinoid $K$-algebra, meaning a reduced quotient of a Tate algebra $K\langle T_1,\ldots,T_n\rangle$ of restricted power series. Write $C^\circ$ for the elements $c$ for which the set $\{c^m:m\geq0\}$ is bounded in the affinoid Banach topology. Let $D\subseteq C^\circ$ be a $V$-subalgebra which, with its induced topology, is a quotient of $V\langle T_1,\ldots,T_r\rangle$ and whose natural map $D\otimes_VK\to C$ is an isomorphism. Then $C^\circ$ is a finite $D$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. The zero affinoid algebra is allowed.

source.place: Theorem 3.5.5, Step 2, printed p. 22; BGR §6.4 and 6.4.1/4 as cited there; primary PDF read online, archival copy WANTED.
